headword: {三角定規|さんかくじょうぎ}

definitions.explanation: A triangular drafting tool used for drawing straight lines and angles. In Japan, students typically use a set of two: one with 30-60-90 degree angles and one with 45-45-90 degree angles.

examples.english: I drew a line with a set square.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard school supply in Japan. Elementary school students learn to use set squares in arithmetic class. The two standard types are the 30-60-90 triangle and the 45-45-90 triangle. Part of the standard stationery set alongside a ruler (⟦{定規|じょうぎ}→定規：04280_jougi⟧), compass (⟦コンパス→コンパス：05595_konpasu⟧), and protractor (⟦{分度器|ぶんどき}→分度器：05596_bundoki⟧).
